newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London down after Tokyo slide.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London down after Tokyo slide.

text.p: Japanese shares were weaker in London following a sharp drop in Tokyo overnight but trading volumes were light ahead of the Christmas holidays, dealers said.
"We've seen a bit of a markdown after Tokyo's fall but it's been very quiet. Everyone is looking forward to going home," one dealer said.
In Tokyo on Tuesday, the Nikkei 225 index plunged 528.75 points or 2.69 percent to a 12-month low of 19,161.71 as investors fretted about Japan's economic prospects, dealers and strategists said.

It was the third-largest fall in the Nikkei this year. Tokyo stocks have been battered by a sell-off that took hold last week when the government confirmed it would tighten fiscal policy next year to tackle the nation's budget deficit, with possible harmful effects on the economy.
The Nikkei ISE 50 index was down 22.10 points at 1,392.87 by 1040 GMT.
